rules.label: leftover
rules.why: Prefetch trace of the app's own executable (FS-PREFETCH: unique exe name and path hash).

rules.label: user_data
rules.why: Notepad++ per-user settings; its backup\ subfolder holds unsaved documents from the session snapshot feature, so the folder is user data.

rules.label: ambient
rules.why: StateRepository cache rows (v1 run: ApplicationUser/PackageUser rows for the NotepadPlusPlus sparse package) are maintained by the AppX deployment service; report-only, only the package API may change them.

rules.label: ambient
rules.why: SysMain prefetch trace written for any executable that ran (installer, app, rig); Windows ages them out; not app state.

rules.label: ambient
rules.why: Background Activity Moderator execution record kept by the bam driver; report-only, never a cleaner target.
